name: Reconnect with friends
summary: Stay in touch with friends through a simple rotation so no one goes 30 days without hearing from you.

onboarding.prompt: Who do you want to reconnect with? (optional, stays private)
How many people in the rotation?
How often do you want to reach out?
onboarding.reaction: We'll space it so it feels natural.

phases.name: First round
benchmarks: Everyone on the list contacted once

phases.name: Rotation
benchmarks: No one goes 30 days without contact

plan_blueprint.calendar: Reach-out reminders at the chosen times naming the next person in the rotation, plus a monthly meet-up suggestion.

approach_variants.habit: Reach out during an existing routine (commute, lunch); streak of weeks.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: reconnect with everyone on the list in 30 days.
approach_variants.time: Each reach-out is a short calendar block.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen treat after each full rotation.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers contact details and message starters.

guardrails: Names and notes about friends stay private to you.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed reach-outs move the person to the top of the next slot. After a quiet month, the plan restarts the first round with a short catch-up message template.
